description: This file defines the XYDataReader class, which provides functionality to read an XYData object from a file. It includes methods to open a file, process its lines into Point3D objects, and log data ranges.

classes.name: XYDataReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading XYData objects from text files.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Public static method to read XYData from a specified file, with error handling for file existence and IOException.

methods.name: doReadFile
methods.description: Private static method that performs the actual file reading, line processing, and data accumulation, including logging of data ranges.
